env: Node: process field holding the environment
argv: Node: process field holding the command line
cwd: Node: process method answering the working directory
platform: Node: process field naming the operating system
version: Node: process field holding the runtime version
versions: Node: process field holding the dependency versions
pid: Node: process field holding the process id
ppid: Node: process field holding the parent process id
arch: Node: process field naming the CPU architecture
execPath: Node: process field holding the executable path
execArgv: Node: process field holding the runtime options
nextTick: Node: process method scheduling a callback
setTimeout: Node: global scheduling a delayed callback
setInterval: Node: global scheduling a repeating callback
queueMicrotask: WHATWG HTML: global scheduling a microtask
__dirname: Node: CommonJS module global holding the directory
__filename: Node: CommonJS module global holding the file path
schedule: suss: effect class for a scheduled callback
